messages:
michelle: Heads-up — staging preview for the runtime KB shows several images 404ing in the KV cache section and one inline SVG in the TOC. Screenshot: https://staging.kb.redwood.internal/preview.png Can someone claim a quick rehost+PR?

alex: Saw it, thanks for flagging. If it's only images we can rehost to kb-assets and update the markdown paths.

jamie: I can take the mini patch. Quick question: how many images exactly?

michelle: total 4: three screenshots under 'kv cache' (kv-cache-1/2/3.png) and one toc-inline.svg. Staging returns 403 for all.

alex: FYI — use the kb-assets bucket: `s3://kb-assets/runtime/` and keep filenames stable. Example sed to update paths locally: 
```
git grep -l "assets.s3.amazonaws.com/old-path" | xargs sed -i "s|https://assets.s3.amazonaws.com/old-path|https://kb-assets.s3.amazonaws.com/runtime|g"
```

jamie: cool, I'll rehost and open a tiny CR with the path updates + alt text. pinging @rachel in case she wants to review (she owns the runtime guide).

rachel: yep I own that chapter, thanks for picking it up. Quick ask — add descriptive alt text for the screenshots and update the tiny caption under the first image. Otherwise LGTM.

jamie: filing PR now, will include alt text and caption change. ETA ~1h. Marking as claimed.

docs-bot: PR opened by jamie: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kb/pull/1224 — CI queued.

michelle: amazing, thanks team :thumbsup:
